tagline: Energy and environmental services provider for sustainable urban infrastructure
hero_kpi_rationale: The Smart Infrastructures segment captures the digital transformation of urban and energy networks, aligned with European smart cities and decarbonization trends. This unit embodies A2A's strategy for structural growth in intelligent network management technologies.

kpis.name: Smart Infrastructures segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by digital services for intelligent energy and urban networks.
kpis.description: The Smart Infrastructures segment is progressing thanks to investments in smart meters and digital network management, including integration of strategic electricity distribution assets.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by network digitalization and major acquisitions.

kpis.name: Gross operating margin (EBITDA)
kpis.explanation: Gross operating profit before depreciation and amortization, expressed in millions of euros.
kpis.description: Gross operating margin reached a record high of 2,328 million euros, reflecting the contribution of Generation & Trading and Market units as well as increased operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Net profit
kpis.explanation: Annual net profit of the group.
kpis.description: Net profit reached 864 million euros, up 31% compared to 2023, reflecting exceptional operating performance and efficient cost management.

kpis.name: Renewable energy production
kpis.explanation: Total annual renewable energy production, including hydroelectric, solar, wind and biological sources.
kpis.description: Renewable energy production reached 6.9 TWh, of which 6 TWh comes from hydroelectric, solar and wind sources, and 0.9 TWh from biological sources. This 27% growth significantly contributes to decarbonization.
kpis.signal: Major expansion of renewable energy portfolio.

kpis.name: CO2 emissions avoided
kpis.explanation: Equivalent tons of CO2 avoided through the group's projects and installations.
kpis.description: Through renewable energy production installations, district heating networks and energy efficiency solutions, the group avoided 3.3 million tons of CO2 emissions.

kpis.name: Direct CO2 emissions
kpis.explanation: Direct carbon dioxide emissions of the group.
kpis.description: The group's direct emissions decreased by 18% to reach 4.6 million tons of CO2, reflecting increased renewable energy production and improved operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Total investments
kpis.explanation: Annual total investments of the group, including acquisitions and organic investments.
kpis.description: Total investments reached 2,941 million euros, a record high, of which 1,512 million euros allocated to organic investments (up 10%), reflecting the commitment to digital transformation and energy transition.
kpis.signal: Record historical level of investments for growth and energy transition.

kpis.name: Sustainable debt ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total debt linked to sustainable financing aligned with European taxonomy.
kpis.description: The sustainable debt ratio reached 78%, up 8 percentage points, consolidating the group's commitment to sustainable financing, confirmed by the issuance in January 2025 of the first European corporate Green Bond.
kpis.signal: Leadership in sustainable financing and transition toward green economy.

kpis.name: Waste collection rate
kpis.explanation: Average percentage of separate waste collection in served areas.
kpis.description: The average separate collection rate reached 71% in served regions, and the group's installations directed over 1.1 million tons of waste toward raw material recovery.

kpis.name: Retail customer base growth
kpis.explanation: Number of new retail energy customers acquired during the period.
kpis.description: The group added over 150,000 new customers to its retail energy customer base, demonstrating the strength of its value proposition to Italian consumers.
kpis.signal: Solid retail customer expansion driven by competitive pricing policies.

kpis.name: Distribution network coverage
kpis.explanation: Extent of the electricity distribution network operated in kilometers.
kpis.description: Following the major 2024 acquisition of distribution assets in the Milan province and Valtrompia (Brescia), the group's network covers more than 17,000 km, serving approximately 800,000 delivery points (PODs) and 9,500 substations.
kpis.signal: Significant expansion of distribution assets following major acquisitions.

kpis.name: Smart Infrastructures segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by digital services for intelligent energy and urban networks.
kpis.description: The segment is progressing thanks to acquisition of smart networks and meter modernization, contributing to sustainable urban transformation.
kpis.signal: Growth sustained by digital transition and network digitalization.

kpis.name: Renewable energy production expansion
kpis.explanation: Growth in the group's annual renewable energy production.
kpis.description: For the first time in A2A's history, renewable energy production equaled production from fossil sources, reaching 6.9 TWh and avoiding 3.3 million tons of CO2 annually.
kpis.signal: Major acceleration of the group's green energy capacity.

kpis.name: Sustainable finance leadership
kpis.explanation: Percentage of debt aligned with environmental, social and governance criteria.
kpis.description: A2A consolidated its leading position with a sustainable debt ratio of 78%, reinforced by the issuance of the first European corporate Green Bond in January 2025.
kpis.signal: Positioning as European leader in sustainable financing and green taxonomy.

kpis.name: Major distribution assets acquisition
kpis.explanation: Strategic expansion of electricity distribution network through acquisition of assets in Lombardy.
kpis.description: A2A acquired the majority of electricity distribution assets in the Milan province and Valtrompia (Brescia), covering 17,000 km of network and 800,000 customers, strengthening its position as leader in integrated multi-services in Northern Italy.
kpis.signal: Completion of Italy's largest sector acquisition.

risks.title: Energy transition and decarbonization of operations
risks.score_rationale: Major risk positioned in E1 (Climate change) with detailed transition plans (E1-1 to E1-8). Intensive language on decarbonization commitments, quantitative targets and Scopes 1-2-3. Growing trend with integration into corporate strategy and remuneration incentives (GOV-3). Dominant categorical weight in ESRS reporting.

risks.title: CSRD regulatory compliance and ESRS standards
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in Board training (CSRD and ESRS Standards). Document structured entirely according to ESRS (E1-E5, S1-S4, G1). Moderate but systematic language. New/growing trend with 2024 implementation. High categorical weight in governance.

risks.title: Management of air, water and soil pollution risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to operations (E2 Pollution) with detailed disclosures (E2-1 to E2-6). Moderate but structured language. Stable trend with defined actions and targets. Significant categorical weight for thermal production and waste management activities.

risks.title: Water resource dependence and water management
risks.score_rationale: Operation-specific risk (E3 Water and marine resources) with disclosures E3-1 to E3-4. Moderate language. Stable trend with defined targets. Medium categorical weight for thermal production and distribution activities.

risks.title: Biodiversity risks and ecosystem impacts
risks.score_rationale: Operation-specific risk (E4 Biodiversity and ecosystems) with transition plan and disclosures E4-1 to E4-5. Moderate language. Stable trend with targets and impact metrics. Medium categorical weight for infrastructure and operating sites.

risks.title: Management of relationships with affected communities
risks.score_rationale: Operation-specific risk (S3 Affected communities) with disclosures S3-1 to S3-5. Moderate but structured language. Stable trend with defined engagement processes. Medium categorical weight for local operations and territorial impacts.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and resilience of critical infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Implicit operation risk for critical infrastructure operators (energy distribution, water, waste management). While not explicitly detailed in the Item 1A provided, it is central to utilities. Language absent from document but operational relevance very high. Growing trend with geopolitical threats.

risks.title: Supply chain and Scope 3 emissions
risks.score_rationale: Operation-specific risk mentioned in Value chain section (page 88). Moderate language with description of EcoVadis platform for tracking supplier emissions. Stable trend but in development. Medium categorical weight for overall decarbonization.

ai_positioning.summary: A2A is progressively integrating predictive analytics and AI technologies in the management of its smart networks and predictive maintenance, without positioning as a technology leader, but as a strategic integrator of digital solutions for urban energy efficiency.
evidence: Deployment of predictive analytics systems for electricity network optimization
Use of smart sensors with real-time data processing on meters and distribution networks
Investments in smart grids and digital management of urban networks
Integration of AI tools in the Smart Infrastructures portfolio for predictive maintenance
